name: agent-activity
purpose: Shows what an agent is doing while it works (Cloudscape progressive steps, AI Elements Chain of Thought): the current step with a running indicator (`Searching the docs`, `Reading 3 files`) and, behind a disclosure, the list of every step with its status from the shared status set. It is the display of the short progress updates an agent streams (TanStack AI `activity` parts and `role: 'activity'` messages), filled from plain props so it stays library-neutral. Screen readers hear a step only when it has been the current one for a second, and the outcome once, never every tick.
useWhen: An agent works through several steps before or while it answers, and the reader should see which step it is on (`Searching the docs`, `Reading 3 files`, `Writing the answer`).
A plan the agent ticks over, step by step, inside a chat message.
avoidWhen: Nothing to report but that an answer is coming → `response-loading`.
A call with side effects, its input and output → `tool-call`; one asking for approval → `tool-approval`.
A build or deploy run with log lines per step → `log-viewer-steps`.
Moving through the pages of a form or wizard → `stepper`.
related: `response-loading` — the waiting state before the first step arrives.
`tool-call` — one call in detail; an activity step can summarize it.
`chat-message` — the bubble the activity sits in.
bestPractices: Title each step `<Verb>ing <what>` in the reader's words, no end punctuation: `Searching the docs`, never a tool identifier.
Keep one step `running` at a time; later steps stay `pending` until they start.
When a step fails, mark it `error` and the steps that will no longer run `canceled`.
Keep the steps collapsed in a chat once the answer arrives; the answer is the main content.
Key each step by something stable, such as the id of the activity message it comes from.
Use 3 to 7 steps; merge fine-grained ticks into one step and update its `description` instead.

props.name: steps
props.doc: The steps of the work, in order: each has a `key`, a `title`, a `status` from the shared status set and an optional `description`. The current step is the first running one, else the first failed one, else the last canceled one of a stopped run, else the last one that is not pending.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Initial open state of the step list when uncontrolled; collapsed shows only the current step.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the activity. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Agent activity`).
